_meanings:
.²1 An ornament, a decoration.
.²2 (Hence) Anything the best of its kind; {#kanyAlalAma kamanIyamajasya#}
 {#lipsoH#} <ls>R. 5. 64</ls> ‘the best or ornament of girls’.
.²3 A banner, flag.
.²4 A sectarial mark, token, sign, symbol.
.²5 A tail.
.²6 A species of stanza (having 10 syllables in the first two Pādas, 11
 in the third and 13 in the fourth); see {#lalAma#}.
